headline: Newcastle 0-1 Aston Villa: Premier League – as it happened
body: Johan Manzambi scored the only goal to give Aston Villa deserved win at St James’ Park A reminder of the teams It looks like Joe Willock will play on the right wing for Newcastle, with Joelinton in midfield alongside Nico Gonzalez. Newcastle (4-2-3-1) Hornicek; Miley, Thiaw, Botman, Hall; Gonzalez, Joelinton; Willock, Wissa, Barnes; Fernandez-Pardo. Continue reading...
